artifacts.summary: Six-phase sequential plan adding Check E (deployed (event, matcher, hook-identity) SET assertion, three distinct drift shapes) to lint-hook-registration-paths.sh, with regression cases, Gate 21 confirmation requiring no verify-deploy.sh or gate-registry.data edit, and a redeploy/full-gate close.

memory_candidates.content: Adding a new CLI flag to one member of this repo's seven-lint cluster requires a pre-pass in that lint's own body that strips the flag from "$@" BEFORE calling lint_corpus_scan_parse_flags: the shared parser (scripts/lib/lint-corpus-scan-lib.sh) is byte-identical across all seven and treats every unrecognized token as a positional scan path, so an unstripped flag lands as a scan path and the caller exits 2 with 'scan path not found: --myflag'. Never widen the shared parser for one lint's flag. Separately, when a gate harness (verify-deploy.sh's gateNN_run) invokes a tool with FIXED arguments, no CLI flag can reach it, so a fixture-driven gate-level demonstration needs an environment-variable override on the tool instead -- lint-hook-registration-paths.sh's own HOOK_IDENTITY_CLI_OVERRIDE is the established precedent, introduced for exactly this purpose (point a test at a deliberate fixture without mutating the real file).
